cohort: All women who experienced a maternal death involving termination of pregnancy by cesarean section in Antioquia, Colombia, during the period 2011-2020 were included.
finding: The study observed a crude relative risk of maternal death of 2.7 for cesarean sections compared to vaginal deliveries, but emphasized the necessity of controlling for indication bias when assessing the causal influence of cesarean section.
mod_finding: The maternal mortality rate was 48.6 per 100,000 cesarean sections and 17.9 per 100,000 vaginal deliveries.
